programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: Would you let AI walk around your home? We explore the growing race to put humanoid robots into our homes and workplaces. We examine Meta's reported robot project, the rise of Chinese robot manufacturers, the privacy risks of machines that can see, hear and map our lives and whether robots are becoming Big Tech's next multi-trillion-dollar bet. Meta has reportedly built a humanoid robot called Max and, if Mark Zuckerberg gets his way, this could be the next frontier for artificial intelligence. After years of AI living on our screens, Silicon Valley is now racing to give AI a body, one that can see, hear, move through the world and interact with people in real life. Could a humanoid robot really become as common as a smartphone? Would you trust one to help around the house, care for an elderly relative, or perform tasks at work? And as companies spend hundreds of billions of dollars on AI, are robots the breakthrough the industry has been waiting for, or another expensive gamble destined to disappoint?

In this episode of abiliTV, we meet the people making skateboarding more accessible, including an ingenious adapted frame giving people with disability the chance to experience the freedom, excitement and confidence of getting on a board. Then, Jackson Hughes from ABC's 'The Assembly' swaps asking the questions for answering them as he takes his place in the Open Floor hot seat. programme.desc: Segmento en el cual podrás ver una recopilación de los más grandes impactos de Dios dentro del ministerio Cristo Viene, con notas de interés, reportajes, crónicas e informes.

programme.title: Club 700 hoy
programme.desc: Una revista con música, entrevistas, temas relevantes y segmentos curiosos de nuestra querida Iberoamérica. Con Amarillis Rivera y Héctor Hermosillo.

programme.title: Vida dura
programme.desc: Presentada por Omar Morillo, esta es una serie dramática sobre la vida real de personas que han experimentado los límites del dolor y el sufrimiento. Escucha al presentador compartir la manera en que es posible triunfar.

programme.title: Clamor
programme.desc: Sea protagonista de este segmento especial en el que el reverendo Jorge Rashcke expone temas de actualidad con un enfoque bíblico, exhortaciones, reflexiones y algo más, para generar un cambio positivo en la vida del público.

programme.title: Viviendo con sentido común
programme.desc: Randy Morrison combina el sentido común, el humor, la pasión sin restricciones y, por último, las experiencias de la vida real con las enseñanzas basadas en la Biblia.

programme.title: Music Box
programme.desc: Espacio que tiene como propósito exaltar el nombre de Dios, a través de letras que te permitirán reencontrarte con el ser supremo.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Terror-Regatta
programme.desc: Sam ist in Geldnot. Deshalb lässt er sich auf ein großzügiges Angebot von Rebeccas reichem Freund Robin ein: Mit dessen Luxusyacht nimmt Sam an einer Regatta um ein hohes Preisgeld teil. Auf hoher See im Siegestaumel entdeckt Sam eine Bombe an Bord.

programme.title: Cheers: Sam und die Professorin
programme.desc: Rebecca erhält Besuch von ihrer früheren College-Professorin, der renommierten Alice Anne Volkman. Rebecca katzbuckelt nach wie vor wie eine brave Studentin vor der hochgeschätzten Professorin.

programme.title: Cheers: Cliffs großer Fernsehauftritt
programme.desc: Cliff ist guter Dinge: Er wurde zu seiner Lieblings-Game-Show "Jeopardy" als Kandidat geladen. An seinem großen Abend wird er von Woody und Norm begleitet.

programme.title: Cheers: Die große Liebe – Teil 1
programme.desc: Rebecca schwebt mit dem Millionär Robin Colcord im siebten Himmel. Allerdings hat sie noch immer nicht mit ihm geschlafen. Als Robin sie zu einem feudalen Galaabend ausführen wil, wähnt Rebecca die Nacht der Nächte gekommen.

programme.title: Cheers: Die große Liebe – Teil 2
programme.desc: Sam weiß, dass Robin Colcord die unwissende Rebecca mit anderen Frauen betrügt. Was soll Sam nun tun? Einerseits will er Rebecca nicht wehtun. Andererseits will er den ruchlosen Robin nicht so einfach davonkommen lassen.

programme.title: Cheers: Die scharfe Schwiegermutter
programme.desc: Woody ist bei allen Verwandten seiner Freundin Kelly durchgefallen. Umso entzückter ist er, als er ihre Mutter Roxanne kennenlernt. Die fidele Lady ist ganz reizend zu ihm.

programme.title: Cheers: Gute Mädchen, schlechte Jungs
programme.desc: Lilith hat ihr Buch mit dem Titel ,,Gute Mädchen, schlechte Jungs" veröffentlicht. Sie tritt damit in einer Talkshow auf. Dort unterstützt sie die These, dass Frauen sich nur schlechte Männer suchen.

programme.title: Cheers: Tag der Träume
programme.desc: Rebecca hat endlich ein Rendezvous mit Robin. Sie glaubt, der ,,Tag ihres Lebens" stehe ihr damit bevor. Bis ins kleinste Detail plant Rebecca alles.

programme.title: Cheers: Erben will gelernt sein
programme.desc: Carla glaubt, von ihrem verstorbenen Mann nur Schulden geerbt zu haben, während er seiner zweiten Frau 100 Dollar vermacht hat. Gerade als die beiden Witwen beschlossen haben, das Erbe zu teilen, erhält Carla eine überraschende Nachricht.

programme.title: Cheers: Krieg der Kneipen – Teil 3
programme.desc: Die Mannschaft vom Cheers vermisst ihren indianischen Glücksbringer Tecumseh. Er muss gestohlen worden sein. So eine niederträchtige Tat trauen die Männer nur einem zu: Gary, dem verfeindeten Kneipier. Prompt folgt die harte Rache.

programme.title: Cheers: Woody auf Freiersfüßen
programme.desc: Woody trägt sich mit dem Gedanken, Kelly zu heiraten. Mr. Gaines hält seine Tochter jedoch für zu jung. Er beschließt, Kelly nach Europa zu schicken. Für die beiden Verliebten heißt es Abschied nehmen.

programme.title: Cheers: Carla sieht Gespenster
programme.desc: Carla glaubt, von ihrem verstorbenen Ex-Mann Eddy verfolgt zu werden. Deshalb heuert sie eine Wahrsagerin an, um mit dem Jenseits Kontakt aufzunehmen. Sogar die unterkühlte Lilith fällt auf den faulen Zauber herein.

programme.title: Cheers: Nachhilfeunterricht in Liebe
programme.desc: Rebecca quält die Eifersucht: Die Französin Jeanne-Marie ist hinter Robin Colcord her. Sie schickt Sam zu einer Party, um Hintergrundinfos über ihre Konkurrentin zu erlangen. Tags darauf behauptet Sam, Jeanne-Marie verführt zu haben.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Heiratsantrag – Teil 1
programme.desc: Rebecca fühlt sich von Robin hintergangen. Sie will sich von ihm trennen. Robin nimmt ihr jedoch den Wind aus den Segeln: Er bittet sie, bei ihm einzuziehen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Heiratsantrag – Teil 2
programme.desc: Sam zeigt Rebeccas Freund Robin bei der Firmenleitung an. Der wird wegen Industriespionage unter Anklage gestellt, kommt aber gegen Kaution wieder auf freien Fuß.

programme.title: Cheers: Ein süßes Geheimnis
programme.desc: Rebeccas große Liebe Robin ist durchgebrannt. Sam präsentiert sich als gefühlvoller Tröster. Nach jahrelangen Annäherungsversuchen kommt er endlich zu der ersehnten Nacht mit Rebecca.

programme.title: Cheers: Spiel, Korb und Sieg für Cheers
programme.sub-title: Spiel, Korb und Sieg für Cheers
programme.desc: Die Cheers-Truppe hat im Kneipenturnier nicht die geringste Chance gegen Garys Mannschaft. Sam heckt einen Plan aus. Er lockt den Profibasketballer McHale in die Cheers-Mannschaft.

programme.title: Cheers: Rebecca, steh uns bei!
programme.desc: Seit Rebecca nicht mehr Geschäftsführerin ist, geht es im Cheers drunter und drüber. Sam muss feststellen, dass er dem Posten nicht gewachsen ist. Er will Rebecca zurückholen.

programme.title: Cheers: Ruhm ist vergänglich
programme.desc: In der Presse wird kolportiert, Robin Colcord habe seine Freiheit und sein Vermögen für eine Frau geopfert. Rebecca fürchtet nun die Reporterscharen, die über das Cheers hereinbrechen werden.

programme.title: Cheers: Mamas Liebling
programme.desc: Stolz gibt Cliff bekannt, dass er sich endlich von seiner Mutter emanzipiert habe. Tatsächlich: Als sie zu Besuch kommt, eröffnet Cliff seiner entsetzten Mutter, dass sie in einem Hotel nächtigen müsse.

programme.title: Cheers: Norm als Bürgerrechtler
programme.desc: Norm ist schwer deprimiert. Nicht einmal sein Bier schmeckt ihm. Der Grund: Sein Lieblingslokal soll abgerissen werden. Frasier schlägt vor, Norman solle etwas gegen die Schließung des Lokals unternehmen.

programme.title: Cheers: Dumm ist, wer Dummes tut
programme.desc: Frasier und Lilith zermürben sich ihre Köpfe darüber, dass ihr Sohn offenbar nur durchschnittlich intelligent ist. Rebecca plagt währenddessen die sexuelle Enthaltsamkeit. Robin schreibt ihr einen schlüpfrigen Brief aus dem Knast.

programme.title: Cheers: Der böse Nachbar Sam
programme.desc: Sams gute Laune ist gedämpft. Der New Yorker Edelgastronom John Allen Hill bezieht mit seinem neuen Restaurant den Raum über dem Cheers. Hill diktiert die neuen Regeln im Haus. Seine Yuppie-Klientel benutzt zudem das Cheers als Wartehalle.

programme.title: Cheers: Eine hochoffizielle Lüge
programme.desc: Woody spielt in einem Werbespot für das vegetarisches Getränk ,,Veggie-Boy" mit. Als der Spot zum ersten Mal ausgestrahlt wird, finden sich alle im Cheers ein. Woody befindet sich jedoch in einem Gewissenskonflikt.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Kreditkarte
programme.desc: Aus Langeweile hecken Norm und Cliff einen Streich aus: Sie rufen bei Frasiers Kreditkartenfirma an. Dort melden sie seine Karte als gestohlen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Franzose

programme.title: Patriot
programme.desc: V americké válce za nezávislost svádí jeden z mužů nejtěžší bitvu hluboko ve svém srdci. Mel Gibson ztvárňuje hlavní roli Benjamina Martina, ovdovělého bývalého vojáka, který se vzdal mimořádných bojových dovedností, aby mohl v klidu a míru vychovávat svých sedm dětí. Zatímco se Benjamin vyrovnává s odhodláním svého nejstaršího syna Gabriela (Heath Ledger) vstoupit do povstalecké armády, válka brzy zaklepe i na dveře jeho domu. Když se sadistický britský plukovním dopustí hrůzného zvěrstva, bývalý válečník, poháněný slepou touhou po pomstě, se znovu chopí zbraně a vede povstalce do zuřivých bojů proti skvěle vyzbrojené anglické armádě, aby bojoval za svou rodinu a za svobodu svého mladého národa.

programme.title: Kurz sebeovládání
programme.desc: Dave Buznik je plachý dobrák, který se kvůli jednomu incidentu v letadle dostane do kursu sebeovládání a jeho život se převrátí naruby. Kurs vede psychiatr Buddy Rydell, který se později, po dalším Davově incidentu, nastěhuje dokonce k němu domů a neustále na něj dohlíží. Dave už je z léčebných postupů šíleného psychiatra zoufalý a když mu ještě Buddy přebere snoubenku, je Dave na zhroucení a už je mu jedno co si o něm jeho okolí myslí. Nakonec se ale ukáže, že bylo všechno trochu jinak, než jak to Dave viděl. Léčba je úspěšně dokončena.

Pak do jeho života vstoupí svobodná matka (Renée Zellweger) a Jerry si uvědomí, že ho čeká to nejtěžší vyjednávání v životě... V sázce je totiž srdce ženy, kterou doopravdy miluje.

programme.title: Mlčení jehňátek
programme.desc: Clarice Starlingová, nadaná studentka na akademii FBI, je přidělena agentovi Crawfordovi, vyšetřujícímu případ masového vraha Buffalo Billa. Ten své oběti stahuje z kůže. Clarice navštíví v baltimorské vězeňské nemocnici bývalého vynikajícího psychiatra Hannibala Lectera, odsouzeného na doživotí za sérii brutálních vražd a kanibalismus. Odsouzený psychiatr Clarice děsí a zároveň fascinuje. Jedna jeho záhadná poznámka studentku dovede k uříznuté hlavě jedné z Buffalo Billových obětí. Když je masovým vrahem unesena dcera senátorky Martinové, nabídne Clarice Lecterovi přijatelnější vězeňské podmínky výměnou za informaci, která by vedla k dopadení Buffalo Billa. Lecter je mezitím převezen do Memphisu na popud ředitele vězeňské nemocnice, který podobnou dohodu učinil jménem senátorky Martinové. Clarice se podaří s Lecterem ještě jednou promluvit a jeho další záhadná informace ji uvede přímo na Buffalo Billovou stopu. Lecter mezitím brutálním způsobem zavraždí své strážce a dostane se...

programme.title: Fargo
programme.desc: Když je na zasněžené silnici v Severní Dakotě nalezen chladnokrevně zavražděný strážník a dva nevinní kolemjdoucí, Marge Gundersonová, policistka v pokročilém stadiu těhotenství, zahájí vyšetřování, které odhalí nebezpečnou hru chamtivosti a břídilství. Jerry Lundegaard, manžel, otec a obchodník s auty z Minneapolisu, který dlouho trpěl v područí svého bohatého šéfa a tchána, vymyslí propracovaný plán, jehož nedílnou součástí je únos vlastní ženy. Chce za ni výkupné ve výši jednoho milionu dolarů, aby mohl splatit nahromaděné dluhy z hazardu. Jenže všechno, co se může pokazit, se nakonec skutečně pokazí. Pod skrovným a přátelským zevnějškem policistky Gundersonové se totiž skrývá bystrá mysl a nelítostné morální postoje, díky nimž lehce prokoukne odfláknutý a mizerně zahlazený zločin, spáchaný zmatenými, ale velice nebezpečnými únosci.

programme.title: Město lží
programme.desc: Detektiv losangeleské policie Russell Poole (Johnny Depp) nedokáže vyřešit svůj největší případ - vraždy hudebních legend Tupaca Shakura a Christophera Wallace přezdívaného Notorious B.I.G. Případ zůstává i po dvaceti letech otevřený. Reportér Jack Jackson (Forest Whitaker), který se zoufale snaží zachránit svou pověst a kariéru, je odhodlán zjistit proč. Spojí síly s Poolem, aby případ konečně uzavřeli. Poole odhaluje neuvěřitelný příběh o moci, korupci a zločinu a Jackson rozplétá síť skandálů a podvodů. Oba muži neúnavně pátrají po pravdě. Podaří se jim rozbít základy losangeleské policie?

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: Píše se rok 2061. Zemi sužuje sucho a hladomor, docházejí základní potraviny a planeta čelí prudkým změnám klimatu. Lidské rase hrozí vyhynutí. Tomu by však mohl zabránit záhadný objev v oblasti výzkumu časoprostoru, díky kterému má lidstvo možná šanci na záchranu. Skupina vědců se musí vydat mimo naši sluneční soustavu a pokusit se najít pro lidské pokolení planetu, na které bude moci žít. Posádka lodi Endurance míří do mezigalaktického neznáma, do míst, kam se ještě nikdo před nimi nedostal. Pilota Coopa čeká zásadní rozhodnutí - bude muset volit mezi tím, zda ještě uvidí své děti, nebo se pokusí zachránit budoucnost lidstva.

programme.title: Nespoutaný Django
programme.desc: Film NESPOUTANÝ DJANGO se odehrává na jihu Spojených států dva roky před vypuknutím Občanské války. Jamie Foxx v něm ztvárnil hlavní roli Djanga - otroka, jehož krutá minulost u bývalých vlastníků přivede tváří v tvář nájemnému lovci lidí německého původu Dr. Kingu Schultzovi. Schultz je na stopě vraždících bratrů Brittlových a jen Django ho může dovést k jeho odměně. Nekonvenční Schultz dá Djangovi slib, že ho pustí na svobodu poté, co dostane Brittlovi - živé či mrtvé. Díky jejich úspěšnému dopadení Schultz Djanga osvobodí, přesto se oba muži rozhodnou i nadále pokračovat ve společné cestě. Schultz pronásleduje s Djangem po svém boku nejhledanější kriminálníky na jihu. Django, který si tříbí životně důležité lovecké schopnosti, se zaměří na jediný cíl: najít a zachránit Broomhildu, ženu, kterou kvůli obchodu s otroky před lety ztratil. Djanga a Schultze jejich hledání nakonec dovede ke Calvinu Candiemu, vlastníkovi jedné neblaze proslulé plantáže zvané "Candyland". Django a...

Django, který si tříbí životně důležité lovecké schopnosti, se zaměří na jediný cíl: najít a zachránit Broomhildu, ženu, kterou kvůli obchodu s otroky před lety ztratil. Djanga a Schultze jejich hledání nakonec dovede ke Calvinu Candiemu, vlastníkovi jedné neblaze proslulé plantáže zvané "Candyland". Django a...

programme.title: Buchty a klobásy
programme.desc: Buchty a klobásy, první mládeži nepřístupný animovaný film, vypráví o skupině potravin, které se pod vedením odvážné uzeniny rozhodnou odhalit pravdu o své existenci. Po vypadnutí z nákupního vozíku se náš hrdina párek a jeho noví přátelé vydají na nebezpečnou cestu napříč supermarketem, aby se vrátili do svých uliček dřív, než nastane 4. červenec, den slev.

programme.title: Matvej a Beate jdou plavat
programme.desc: Křehký příběh o počátku přátelství mezi Matvejem, který nedávno emigroval z Moskvy do Berlína, a Beate, svobodomyslnou místní obyvatelkou

programme.title: Stážisti
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) a Nick (Owen Wilson) jsou prodejci, jejichž kariéru potopil současný přetechnizovaný digitální svět. Ve snaze dokázat, že nepatří do starého železa, se jim podaří téměř nemožné: získat prestižní stáž ve firmě Google. Problém nastane, když zjistí, že zde nejsou sami. Mezi dalšími zájemci o pracovní místa je celá tlupa geniálních univerzitních studentů, Přestože si tedy dokázali proklestit cestu do onoho pověstného světa utopie, mají vyhráno jen napůl. Teď je čeká souboj s elitou národa sestávající z technicky nadaných géniů, v němž mají dokázat, že nutnost je vskutku matkou invence.

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: Píše se rok 2061. Zemi sužuje sucho a hladomor, docházejí základní potraviny a planeta čelí prudkým změnám klimatu. Lidské rase hrozí vyhynutí. Tomu by však mohl zabránit záhadný objev v oblasti výzkumu časoprostoru, díky kterému má lidstvo možná šanci na záchranu. Skupina vědců se musí vydat mimo naši sluneční soustavu a pokusit se najít pro lidské pokolení planetu, na které bude moci žít. Posádka lodi Endurance míří do mezigalaktického neznáma, do míst, kam se ještě nikdo před nimi nedostal. Pilota Coopa čeká zásadní rozhodnutí - bude muset volit mezi tím, zda ještě uvidí své děti, nebo se pokusí zachránit budoucnost lidstva.

programme.title: Město lží
programme.desc: Detektiv losangeleské policie Russell Poole (Johnny Depp) nedokáže vyřešit svůj největší případ - vraždy hudebních legend Tupaca Shakura a Christophera Wallace přezdívaného Notorious B.I.G. Případ zůstává i po dvaceti letech otevřený. Reportér Jack Jackson (Forest Whitaker), který se zoufale snaží zachránit svou pověst a kariéru, je odhodlán zjistit proč. Spojí síly s Poolem, aby případ konečně uzavřeli. Poole odhaluje neuvěřitelný příběh o moci, korupci a zločinu a Jackson rozplétá síť skandálů a podvodů. Oba muži neúnavně pátrají po pravdě. Podaří se jim rozbít základy losangeleské policie?

programme.title: Tess
programme.desc: Román britského spisovatele Thomase Hardyho patří k nejslavnějším viktoriánským románům a dočkal se více než desítky filmových a televizních adaptací. Ve své době vzbudil bouřlivou odezvu vzhledem k jeho kritice puritánské viktoriánské morálky. Odehrává se ve fiktivním jihoanglickém hrabství Wessex. Citlivá, venkovská dívka Tess, nesmlouvavá ve své hrdosti a morálce, se setkává s pokryteckými konvencemi vyšší společnosti. Polský režisér Roman Polanski si do role hlavní hrdinky vybral mladičkou Nastassju Kinskou, které v té době bylo pouhých osmnáct let. Film se celý natáčel ve Francii a dokonce menhiry Stonehenge byly znovu "postaveny".

programme.title: Loupež na úrovni
programme.desc: Crunch je notorický zloděj, ale rád by začal žít jinak. Když ho bratr přemluví, aby se zúčastnil poslední krádeže v životě, dají dohromady starou partu. Plán se však pomalu začíná hroutit... Crunch Calhoun (Kurt Russell) byl v Polsku se svými kumpány a bratrem Nickym, se kterými okradl místního mafiána o pravý obraz od Van Gogha. Při úprku z města, ale došlo k autonehodě a jeho bratr Nicky byl zatčen. Aby se zachránil, začal s policií spolupracovat a práskl Crunche. Ten pak musel jít na sedm let do vězení. Po pěti a půl roce byl propuštěn na svobodu a vydělává si jako kaskadér na motorce. Jeho bratr Nicky stále krade obrazy. Nicky ukradl obraz mužovi jménem Sunny. Policie chtěla Nickyho chytit, ale on je opět převezl a obraz od George Seurata schoval jinam, takže mu interpol nemohl nic dokázat. Interpolu pomáhá bývalý zloděj uměleckých děl Samuel Winter (Terence Stamp). Crunch je se svým kamarádem Franciem, když v tom za ním přijde člověk jménem Sunny, kterého okradl Nicky....

programme.title: The Wire - Špína Baltimoru
programme.desc: S02E02 Fiasko s dárkem pro farnost rozpoutá spor mezi majorem Valchekem a Sobotkou. Valchek požádá komisaře Burella, aby si na Sobotku posvítil. Avon Barksdale řídí své impérium i z cely - radí synovci D ́Angelovi a snaží se dostat strážného, jenž neustále obtěžuje usvědčeného oblíbence Wee-Beye. Seržantka Beatrice Russellová z přístavní policie vyšetřuje podivný náklad v "řecké" nákladní lodi. McNulty nabídne pomoc s vyšetřováním, hlavně proto, aby se pomstil. Nakonec jsou k Russellové přiřazeni detektivové Bunk Moreland a Lester Freamon, aby společně vyšetřili původ mrtvých těl.

Tehdy čerstvě získaný agent J se v organizaci etabloval, zatímco jeho starší zkušený kolega K se vrátil k pohodlnému civilnímu životu a pracuje na poště. Během rutinního vyšetřování však J odhalí spiknutí řízené zlou kytothianskou stvůrou Serleenou, vystupující v podobě sexy modelky luxusního spodního prádla. Serleena však obsadí budovu organizace MIB a jako rukojmí si vezme jeho zaměstnance. K nezbývá než požádat o pomoc jediného muže, který mu s řešením situace může pomoci – zpohodlnělého J.

programme.title: Cold Case Files

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Nine years after the murders of a mother and her teenage daughters, a wiretapped conversation helps police to crack the case. And the baffling murder of a Virginia woman is solved when human bones are discovered by a geologist in North Carolina.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: When a church deacon is found shot to death it looks like police may have stumbled upon a multi-party murder plot. And, a wife remains a key suspect in her husband's murder case for six years, until she attempts to prove her own innocence.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When 23-year-old Tonya McKinley is found brutally murdered on New Years Day 1985, a little boy is left motherless. A family must wait 35 years for advancements in forensic science to finally catch a killer using familial DNA.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: It takes nine years and the work of cutting-edge forensic toxicologists to solve the murder of a medical examiner's wife. Then, a determined Alabama sheriff reopens the case of the deaths of two babies, hoping to get their mother to confess.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: March 1984. Jack Kennedy discovers his daughters brutally murdered. Their mother and niece spend their lives keeping the case alive. DNA leads nowhere. 30 years later, an informant gives up a name.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: New DNA technology and the national DNA databank help police hunt down a rapist-killer 11 years after he committed his crimes, and a detective's painstaking recreation of a woman's shooting death proves it wasn't an accident.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: A killer authors a book about his con-man past that becomes the key to solving a 29-year-old cold case of two high school sweethearts--and three other cold case murders--leading police to believe he could be the Zodiac Killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In July 1997, the brutal murder of 19-year-old Tiffany Johnston rocks the small town of Bethany, Oklahoma. DNA points to her killer over a decade later and leads investigators across state lines.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Guns found dumped in a pond help police to solve the 15-year-old murder of Detroit cab company owner. And the rape and murder of an Atlanta TV station receptionist goes cold for 20 years before DNA links a man to the crime.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In the heart of Cajun country, young mother Brenda DuPont is found murdered in her home in May 1988. The initial investigation sputters and turns cold, but her sister Linda vows to solve her murder.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: After 19 years, Kansas detectives reopen the case of a banker found beaten to death in his bed--and the chief suspect is his cheating wife. And a man with a guilty conscience helps Arkansas police to crack a cold case of murder.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La esposa de un oficial de policía muy respetado es asesinada en su propio hogar. El crimen quedó sin resolver por más de una década, hasta que se forma una nueva unidad de casos sin resolver, que le dan un nuevo vistazo a la evidencia.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Un disparo en la oscuridad
programme.desc: Una mujer es asesinada a tiros. ¿Pero fue un homicidio o un suicidio? Se necesitaría la experiencia de expertos forenses y dos juicios con jurado para determinar el destino del asesino acusado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.sub-title: Asesinato de los Panes de Hamburguesa
programme.desc: En el 2000, Christina Sanoubane fue asesinada en su departamento de Cedar Rapids después de dejar a su abusivo novio. Hay pistas en la escena: huellas sangrientas y ADN del kit de violación de la víctima.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1969, la operadora telefónica de 25 años, Diane Maxwell, es violada y asesinada. Su hermano prometió que averiguaría quién fue el responsable y llevaría al asesino ante la justicia.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El ex amante de un sospechoso se presenta con una fantástica historia de asesinato, mutilación y cremación.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Inyección de venganza
programme.desc: Una enfermera de 34 años experimenta una variedad de síntomas parecidos a los de la gripe. Ninguno de sus médicos logra descubrir la causa, hasta que visita al ginecólogo para un chequeo de rutina.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En las zonas rurales de Canadá, el Dr. John Schneeberger es acusado de sedar y agredir sexualmente a una de sus pacientes y a su hijastra. Las pruebas de ADN demuestran que el doctor es inocente, pero la paciente insiste en que la sedó y violó.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Asesinato en el menú
programme.desc: Cuando el jefe de cocina de un restaurante histórico de Filadelfia fue encontrado muerto, los investigadores entrevistaron a los sospechosos habituales: familiares, amigos y compañeros de trabajo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando se llama a la policía de las Grandes Llanuras por un cadáver, una verificación de antecedentes de la víctima los lleva a una extraña red de vagabundos sin hogar, subastas de ganado y cheques sin fondos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Voto de silencio
programme.desc: Una mirada al caso contra Jack Reeves. Unos amigos informaron que su novia por correo había desaparecido. La policía centró sus sospechas en Reeves y, mientras buscaba pistas, descubrió información que lo vinculaba con la muerte de dos ex esposas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: No había una razón clara para que un joven y saludable estudiante universitario estuviera muerto. Pero cuando el forense descubrió una pequeña pista durante la autopsia, los investigadores pudieron descubrir un misterio lleno de traición y venganza.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando una bomba casera estalló en una casa rural, la policía no tenía idea de quién era el responsable.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Pelo de perro
programme.desc: Sin evidencia forense dentro de la escena del crimen, los investigadores estaban desconcertados. Pero sospecharon que el perro de la víctima había sido testigo del crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una mujer de 19 años fue encontrada muerta en su automóvil; la escena se había organizado para que el asesinato pareciera un suicidio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra un cuerpo descompuesto metido en un barril, es fácil suponer un asesinato. Pero el cuerpo había sido colocado en el barril 30 años antes. Una de las pocas pistas fue una libreta de direcciones que se encontró junto con el cuerpo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2008, la universitaria Jenna Verhaalen fue encontrada muerta en su departamento de Bryan, Texas y las hemorragias petequiales en sus ojos indicaron que fue estrangulada.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La investigación sobre un brutal ataque a dos niños cerca de un estanque se basa en pruebas extraídas de las aguas turbias. Fue el primer caso en el que se utilizó evidencia de Diatomea (algas) para ubicar a un sospechoso en la escena del crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Destinado a la cárcel
programme.desc: Una mujer es encontrada muerta en un barranco, pero las fuertes tormentas habían arrastrado pruebas cruciales de la escena del crimen. En dos ocasiones, el rastro se estancó.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Evidencia del Jefe
programme.desc: Se detalla el asesinato en Seattle de 1996 de la pareja suburbana Raquel Rivera y Jay Johnson. La evidencia del perro, Chief, de la pareja finalmente vincula a uno de los asesinos a la escena.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El cuerpo de una mujer joven fue descubierto en una granja aislada cerca de Delano, California. Ella no tenía identificación, pero la policía encontró las llaves de un buzón de correo en los bolsillos de sus pantalones.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La víctima había ingerido una gran cantidad de cianuro. Una pista muy improbable: una falla en el sobre de correo, expuso a un asesino que estaba dispuesto a matar a gente inocente.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2006, Darlene Vander Giesen recibió correos electrónicos amenazantes y luego desapareció. Rastrear los correos electrónicos llevó a la policía a la casa de Daphne Wright, donde creen que se cometió un asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Bruce Miller fue asesinado a tiros en la oficina del negocio de depósito de chatarra que poseía. La escena del crimen estaba casi inmaculada.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Las vacaciones familiares se convierten en una pesadilla cuando a una mujer la encuentran boca abajo en un lago.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El Septiembre de 1984, en un suburbio de Tucson, Arizona, Vicki Hoskins, de ocho años, salió de su casa en su bicicleta rosada para enviar una carta a su madre. Ella nunca regresó, pero su bicicleta ligeramente dañada fue encontrada en las cercanías.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1996, Derrick Duehren regresó para encontrar su casa en Oregon hecha cenizas. Los restos calcinados de su esposa se encontraron luego en los escombros. Los investigadores intentaron determinar si fue un accidente desafortunado o un asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los investigadores examinan las cenizas de un incendio que mató a una mujer de 40 años. El fuego parecía haber sido iniciado por un cigarrillo desatendido.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Las vida cambia después de 20 años de haber transcurrido un crimen sin resolver, y lo mismo ocurre con la medicina forense. Hoy en día, un microscopio de alto poder y el perfil de ADN, revelan una pista que nadie había visto antes.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder
programme.desc: When Lorene Austin turns up at a police station claiming she found her best friend LaNell Barsock shot to death in her garage, she points the finger at Lannell’s live-in boyfriend Lewis Bonheuer.

programme.title: Murder By Medic
programme.desc: Gail Katz's family thought her disappearance was solved when a torso washes up, but the truth unfolds thousands of feet above the ocean.

programme.title: Spring Break Murders
programme.desc: October 2023. In May 2005, 18-year-old Natalee Holloway takes a Spring Break trip to Aruba with her girlfriends to celebrate their last year of high-school.

programme.title: Murder at the Motel
programme.desc: Baltimore, MD. Police officers respond to a report of a deceased man found at the Deluxe Plaza Motel in Northeast Baltimore. The victim, US Navy Veteran Edward Yesaitis, was discovered by the motel's cleaning crew.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Lois and David Riess were grandparents and business owners. Lois was also a gambling addict who would do anything to feed her habit. David became the first victim of a murderous rampage that earned Lois the title of America’s most wanted grandmother.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: In Mobile, a father of four is found dead inside a car after a mysterious crash, and detectives discover that his death was no accident.

programme.title: Somebody's Hiding Something
programme.desc: 24-year-old Rosa Ambriz is certain that something bad has happened to her father Raul Guillen. Raul speaks with his daughter every day on the phone. After more than a week without hearing from him, Rosa calls Jackson County Detective Cheree Edwards.

programme.title: Somebody's Hiding Something
programme.desc: In a peaceful Maine town, 16-year-old Joyce McLain is out for a run when she disappears. The next morning, the cheerleader’s lifeless body is found next to the high school where she was just about to begin her junior year.

programme.title: Somebody's Hiding Something
programme.desc: In May 2015, a burnt-out car is found in a parking garage on the outskirts of an Edmonton. Investigators struggle to find who would want to kill mild-mannered, fun-loving, life-of-the-party Dwayne Demkiw.

programme.title: Somebody's Hiding Something
programme.desc: Police in Jasper, Texas, are quick to connect a missing person’s report and an abandoned pickup truck. The search is on for 58-year-old Martin Byerly, a hard-working mechanic known for drinking, womanising, and carrying a big wad of cash.

programme.title: Sunshine Slayings
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes a small Caribbean island when four tourists are found shot to death aboard their yacht. With little evidence and no motive, can investigators catch the killer before it’s too late?

programme.title: Spring Break Murders
programme.desc: In May 1993, 20-year-old Christine Lazzaro disappeared after leaving a nightclub in Daytona Beach and was found shot dead hours later.

programme.title: Murder at the Motel
programme.desc: July 9th, 2018, police receive a distressing call from a woman claiming she and her friends have been kidnapped and terrorized at a Travelodge. One of them has sustained a fatal gunshot wound.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder
programme.desc: When Anna Hlavka, a popular young woman from Portland, Oregon is found sexually assaulted and strangled to death in her apartment in 1979, police set their sights on numerous men within her inner circle as the possible killer.

programme.title: Murder By Medic
programme.desc: Two brilliant minds, one with murderous intent. The tragic death of Dr Autumn Klein came at the hands of her husband, Dr Robert Ferrante, whose knowledge of cyanide poisoning meant his wife would never divorce him.

programme.title: Murder By Medic

programme.title: Deadly Women: Hearts of Stone
programme.desc: Deadly Women are not always the ones you expect. They are not the strangers lurking in the dark, they are a young mother, a supportive wife and a grandmother - all killers. Behind their loving masquerade lies a wake of family horror and pain.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The heaviest judgments of convicted killers are reserved for those who committed premeditated murder. These women plot and plan. They know the consequences of their actions, but still they go forward to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Greed is one of the oldest motives for murder, and these deadly women are no exception: they’ll do anything to satisfy their need for cash. This is the dangerous world of the fortune hunters.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Behind lace-curtained windows and beneath sensible haircuts lurked evil. Appearances were deceptive. We did not notice these female killers walking by. These women wore a mask of sanity.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A rifle in a shopping mall, a syringe of potassium chloride and a syringe of insulin, each in the hands of a mentally disturbed woman, lead to the tragic end of many lives.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Psychopathic killers lurk in society, mostly acting alone. Sometimes fate brings them into contact with another person who shares their cold power to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women burn madly with jealousy, an anger so deep they’ll kill to satisfy it. What makes them turn from “green with envy” to “lethal with jealousy?" Find out as we explore their hearts of darkness.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Mystery of Mona Lisa
programme.desc: When Lyssa points out that the fugitive in the next case has the same birth date as Barbara, Dog's recently deceased daughter, the team takes a special vow to capture the young woman.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rusty Cuffs
programme.desc: Dog finds himself fighting two enemies; the law and his inner demons. He continues his legal battle to fight extradition to Mexico in connection with his 2003 capture of fugitive rapist Andrew Luster. His other struggle is private.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Make a Wish
programme.desc: Dog shows his love of justice and children in this poignant episode. He begins by giving encouragement to a group of handicapped children, then starting the search for Jacob, a fugitive who's abandoned his wife and children.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tough Love
programme.desc: Michael is out on bail for drug sales, theft, and violation of parole. Dog's after him for failing to appear in court and his only lead is Jen, his co-signer and girlfriend.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surprise Ending
programme.desc: Dog and the boys are going after a fugitive with a $25,000 bond and a string of theft charges behind him. When the team hits his apartment, they find a boot print on the door, a souvenir of a police raid from only days earlier?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Big Wipe-Out
programme.desc: A Hawaiian surfing hero is on a wave to nowhere and it's Dog's turn to play lifeguard. "Buttons," known throughout the islands for his prowess on the waves and his daring 360's, has wiped-out on the rocky shoals of drug addiction.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: You Can Bet On It!
programme.desc: Kristine had a string of gambling and forgery charges before she jumped bail leaving Dog "holding the bag". Now it's time for Dog to call in some chits of his own, getting the help of trusty informants he's helped out over the years.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fly Boy
programme.desc: Dog told him not to go, but Charles went anyway, skipping to Oregon against the terms of his bail. Now Dog has a tip that Charles plans to slip back into Honolulu. With $30,000 on the line Dog knows he can leave little to chance.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Guns & Ice
programme.desc: The following day is Dog's birthday but that won't stop him from chasing a fugitive, who is facing firearms charges. Dog doesn't relish the thought of going after an alleged gunslinger on his birthday but he's never one to avoid a challenge.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Good Fight
programme.desc: Dog and Beth have to be at the state capitol bright and early to receive an award for their fight against ice in Hawaii. Afterwards, they're inspired to start the hunt for Shanna, an alleged ice user and identity thief with $80,000 in bonds.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Smackdown of Baby Lyssa
programme.desc: After meeting with the cosigner on a bond for a man named John, Dog and the Posse hatch a plan to lure him to a high rise apartment. But when night falls, their plan leaves a member of the team alone and in harm's way!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A Friend in Need
programme.desc: Roger has 27 prior arrests, spent years in jail and doesn't want to go back. But he's missed court and now Dog has to bring him in. To complicate matters, this fugitive lives in a tightly-knit community where good information won't come easy.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Your Lying Eyes
programme.desc: Kolani's on the run, left his wife to look after four kids and left Dog holding the bag for the $10k bond. So their pursuit on this case takes them into some parts of Ohau, and the human heart, that few of us will ever see.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Crime Don't Pay
programme.desc: Today the crew is hunting for Holly, a car thief. She's one of Tim's bonds and the entire Dog crew knows that means trouble - or at least a long and difficult chase.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Twisted Love
programme.desc: Dog is tracking down Cecilia, who's wanted for car theft, but she's nowhere to be found. Her girlfriend and co-signer has gone missing too. Just when the trail goes cold, a friend leads the team to the cosigner's empty apartment.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Where the Wild Things Are
programme.desc: Dog, Beth and the team are in Colorado and they face a special challenge - getting the kids to camp. After the drop-off, Dog is more than ready to track down a fugitive. Robin disposed of a body after a homicide, and now he's skipped his court date.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: No Luv Still
programme.desc: Dog is in search of a potentially dangerous fugitive, he's only 19 and charged with kidnapping and menacing. The case takes an unexpected turn when the Chapman clan ends up in a confrontation with the suspect's family.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Day of the Dog
programme.desc: Dog and the team are back in Colorado hunting bounties. Today's fugitive has a long rap sheet and a reputation for packing heat. With nothing but an address and phone number, the team heads out on the hunt.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Time to Cry
programme.desc: Kimo does a vanishing act for his day in court and now Dog and the posse have to find him. With precious few leads to follow Dog turns to the fugitive's on-again-off-again girlfriend, but she's initially reluctant to join the hunt.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Up on the Roof
programme.desc: Today, Dog and the family are back in Colorado and are about to make one of their most exciting captures ever. When the adrenaline-fueled arrest goes down, every family member will play a critical role.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Business
programme.desc: Dog and the Chapman clan start their hunt today with another well-established bail bonding family. As Dog's fame has grown, so have his responsibilities.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Felons Interrupted
programme.desc: Dog is confronted with two alleged felons in crisis. Family and friends of these bondees are convinced that they are getting into further trouble while awaiting trial, so Dog and the posse have to bring these men back to jail.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Let It Snow
programme.desc: Christopher is barely 21, already has a history of domestic abuse and assault, and is facing major time in a room without a view. This hunt won't be easy for Dog - the leads are few, informers and family are not forthcoming.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rush from Judgment
programme.desc: Facing hard time for forging checks, Melissa pulled a vanishing act at her sentencing hearing, bolting from the courthouse in broad daylight. Lucky for her bondsman, Dog and his posse are in Colorado and ready to help.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Burn & Return
programme.desc: Dog is busy. First, he's after a fugitive who is allegedly an expert in the game of "burn and return"- shoplifting goods to return them for cash refunds. But he's not easy to track.

programme.title: Kellen Erskine
programme.desc: Kellen Erskine was featured on season 7 of NBC's America's Got Talent. His jokes have appeared in many publications including the Reader's Digest. This year he performed at the prestigious Bridgetown Comedy Festival in Portland, Oregon. Kellen opens regularly for Frank Caliendo of FOX's NFL Sunday.

programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E06 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Salomon Gore - Tex Maxi Race
programme.desc: More than just a trail-race the Maxi Race takes runners on an 85km journey around the unique landscape of Lake Annecy, France. Athletes choose the Ultra, Vertical-Race or Marathon, pushing themselves to develop mountain skills and face their own personal challenges. The Salomon Gore-Tex Maxi Race is one of the best and most demanding trail running events, staged in the stunning lake and mountain scenery of the Haute Savoie.

programme.title: Aussie Racer
programme.desc: S01E03 Hosted by Australian motorsport legend Sandy Bowman. In 2013 Sandy Bowman and his navigator Daniel Hardman destroyed their off road race car in a massive crash. They have set out to build a new one, which is a huge undertaking, so to stay entertained Sandy and Daniel decided to compete in other forms of racing whilst the new car is being developed. Every episode Sandy and Daniel enter different events and wholeheartedly get into the spirit of that form of racing.

programme.title: Sports Adventure
programme.desc: S06E05 Romaniacs! The ultimate enduro off-road motorcycle race. Riders form over 40 countries flock to Romania for this crazy 5-day race, where only the toughest, most skilled and resourceful riders will emerge victorious. Will Johnny Walker repeat as champion after becoming the youngest champion ever in last year's event? Graham Jarvis is looking to win the event for a fifth time and Paul Bolton is looking for his third straight win in the hazardous Prologue event that takes place on the streets of Sibiu and determines the starting order of the Red Bull Romaniacs.

programme.desc: S01E01 The Freeride World Tour (FWT) expands to Asia! The season kick-off of the world's most important freeride series for skiers and snowboarders will be held at Hakuba (JPN), the first time ever the FWT stops in the Far East. The second stage of the tour will also guest at a new location, champagne powder paradise Kicking Horse near Golden, British Columbia (CAN). The series continues with the well-proven spectacular slopes of Vallnord-Arcalís (AND), Fieberbrunn (AUT), and Verbier (SUI).

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E07 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork Meets Robin Williams

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mindy, Mindy, Mindy

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork The Swinging Single

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork and The Family Reunion
programme.desc: When Mindy eats one of Mork's gourmet delights, she turns into a wacky Orkan herself, sending her family reunion into a rollicking tizzy and treating pompous old Uncle Dave (special guest star Jonathan Winters) to a bizarre evening he won't forget.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: I Heard It Through The Morkvine
programme.sub-title: I Heard It Through The Morkvine
programme.desc: Mork, who doesn't understand why people gossip, reveals some hilarious inside scoops when he shows and tells all about his friends while subbing for Mindy as host of a local TV show called Rumor Has It.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mindy and Mork
programme.desc: When Mindy has to work long hours on a new TV call-in show, Mork has to help with the housework. But when his comedic cleaning efforts turn the apartment into a disaster area, he calls up Mindy, on the air, for a new set of instructions.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Regrets and Reflections
programme.desc: Mr. Bickley's 50th birthday celebration turns into a crazy exchange of everybody's deepest secrets, but Mindy waits until the group leaves to tell Mork somthing she's wanted to say for years.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: The Wedding
programme.desc: Mindy is the beautiful bride and Mork is the outrageously funny groom - who may not be able to fit into his tuxedo if he can't convince Orson to approve the marriage and undo his transformation of Mork into an English sheep dog.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Three The Hard Way
programme.desc: Mork and unsuspecting Mindy hatch a comedy plot that's bigger than both of them when an egg emerges from Mork's navel that grows and grows until it bursts open and out pops their full-grown, middle-aged-looking son.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mama Mork, Papa Mindy
programme.desc: Mindy is dazed at the reality that she and Mork are the parents of Mearth -half-earthling/half-orkan with the body of a 50-year-old and the mind of an infant and feels lef t out when Mearth accepts Mork as his mommy.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: PS 2001
programme.desc: Mearth hates his first day of school on planet Ork so much that Mork and Mindy accompany him back to Ork Prep, where Mork's ancient teacher - who looks like a child - is still sternly in charge.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Metamorphosis - The TV Show
programme.desc: Mindy, already worried about losing her job at the television station, foresees disaster when Mork and Mearth accidentally transfer minds, forcing her to take Mearth in Mork’s body to meet the new boss.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Drive, She Said
programme.desc: Terror-stricken Mork believes the examiner assigned to give him a driving test is an incarnation of the devil, and careens along the test course in a spectacular tilted wheelie, with Mindy and Mearth in the car.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Midas Mork
programme.desc: All that glitters is Mork's gold when the Orkan learns how to make the precious metal from polyester, buys Mindy a 60-room mansion where she can stable her new horse and hires tennis star Tracy Austin as son Mearth's tennis coach.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Gotta Run (Part 1)
programme.desc: Mork is overjoyed that he and Mindy can finally let it all hang out when he meets Kalnik - an alien from Neptune who apparently is also married to an earthling and the four seem to have everything in common.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork's Mixed Emotions

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mork's Best Friend

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: It's a Wonderfull Mork

programme.desc: A 14th-century Crusader returns to a homeland devastated by the Black Plague. A beleaguered church, deeming sorcery the culprit of the plague, commands the two knights to transport an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in hopes of ending the pestilence. A priest, a grieving knight, a disgraced itinerant and a headstrong youth who can only dream of becoming a knight join a mission troubled by mythically hostile wilderness and fierce contention over the fate of the girl. programme.title: iCarly: Der Knöchelschwur
programme.desc: Carly bekommt eine Zwei Plus für eine Geschichtsarbeit, für die sie eine Eins verdient hätte. Sam nutzt die Möglichkeit während eines wöchentlichen Treffens mit Schulleiter Franklin und ändert Carlys Note am Computer in eine Eins.

programme.title: iCarly: Fan des Grauens
programme.desc: Das iCarly-Team kann sich über mangelnden Zuspruch wahrlich nicht beklagen - doch ein Fan stellt alle anderen in den Schatten: Mandy bombardiert Carly & Co. mit Zuneigungsbekundungen aller Art.

programme.title: iCarly: Kunst und Krise
programme.desc: Carly läd Spencers künstlerisches Vorbild Harry Joyner dazu ein, einen Blick auf Spencers Arbeiten zu werfen. Als Harry diese aber als amateurhaft einstuft, verliert Spencer seinen Sinn des Lebens.

programme.title: iCarly: Zieh die Hose bis zum Hals
programme.sub-title: Zieh die Hose bis zum Hals
programme.desc: Sam und ihr neuer Freund sind unzertrennlich. Aber als die Beziehung auch Einfluss auf iCarly nimmt, beschließen Carly und Freddie etwas dagegen zu tun.

programme.title: iCarly: Fang das Küken!
programme.desc: Für ein naturwissenschaftliches Schulprojekt wollen Carly und Sam einige Küken ausbrüten. Die Küken schlüpfen allerdings früher als erwartet und flüchten aus dem Brutkasten. Carly und Co. müssen die Küken überall suchen.

programme.title: iCarly: Geschenkt ist geschenkt
programme.desc: Carly schenkt ihrer Freundin Sam zum Jahrestag ihrer Freundschaft ein selbst bedrucktes T-Shirt. Umso entsetzter ist Carly, als Sam das Kleidungsstück wenig später gegen Konzertkarten eintauscht. Es kommt zu einem großen Streit.

programme.title: iCarly: Sponsorenglück
programme.desc: Carly und Co. werden in das Büro von "Daka" eingeladen. Ihnen wird eine Stange Geld dafür geboten, Werbung auf iCarly für "Daka's" neuen Schuh, den Tech-Foot, zu machen. Aber die neuen Schuhe stellen sich als schrecklich heraus.

programme.title: iCarly: Nachsitzen für alle!
programme.desc: Der 50. iCarly-Webcast steht bevor. Doch Sam wird kurz vor dem Ausstrahlungstermin zum Nachsitzen verdonnert. Die Strafstunden muss sie ausgerechnet zum Zeitpunkt der geplanten Sendung absitzen. Jetzt ist guter Rat teuer.

programme.title: iCarly: Räuber und Piraten
programme.desc: Zwei Cops haben sich bei Carly und Spencer eingenistet, denn sie haben den dringenden Verdacht, dass im Laden gegenüber Raubkopien von DVDs verkauft werden.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein schickes Angebot
programme.desc: Die Eliteschule Briarwood zieht in Erwägung, Carly ein Stipendium anzubieten. Carly ist sich nicht sicher, ob sie dieses Angebot annehmen soll. Doch Sam und Freddie wissen, sie müssen Carlys Meinung ändern.

programme.title: iCarly: Fechten wir's aus!
programme.desc: Freddie braucht eine Auszeit von den Mädchen. Daher ist er Spencer mehr als dankbar, als er ihn fragt, ob er mit zum Fechten kommen möchte. Allerdings wird es kompliziert, als Spencer ihn gegen den fiesen Doug Toder antreten lässt.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly TV
programme.desc: Der Programmchef eines großen Fernsehsenders ist auf der Suche nach einem neuen Hit und will iCarly zur TV Show machen. Aber Carly und Co. sind bald enttäuscht von den großen Veränderungen, die der Programmchef durchsetzen möchte.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Dreifach-Date
programme.desc: Als ihr Freund Gibby zu schüchtern ist, ein Mädchen, welches er toll findet, um eine Verabredung zu bitten, beschließen Carly und Co. eine Gewinnshow zu machen, bei der er ein Date gewinnen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly wird von den iWeb Awards auserwählt, in Japan für den Preis der Besten Comedy anzutreten. Carly, Sam und Freddie proben für den Auftritt einen Extra-Sketch ein und reisen zusammen mit Spencer und Mrs. Benson nach Japan.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 2
programme.desc: Da der Flieger nicht in Japan landet, müssen Carly und Co. mit dem Fallschirm abspringen, um zu den iWeb Awards zu kommen. Alles scheint gut zu gehen, bis sie auf Kyoko und Yuki treffen, die eine gemeinen Plan verfolgen.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 3
programme.desc: Nachdem Kyoko und Yuki Carly und Co. im Nirgendwo ausgesetzt haben, laufen die Drei völlig verzweifelt durch die Gegend. Spencer und Mrs. Benson, die sich befreit haben, versuchen, die Kids zu finden. Schaffen sie es rechtzeitig, Carly zu finden?

programme.title: iCarly: Alle lieben Shane
programme.desc: Als sich Carly und Sam für den gleichen Jungen interessieren, schwören sie sich, ihn nicht zwischen sie kommen zu lassen. Als sich jedoch beide um seine Aufmerksamkeit bemühen, wird ihre Freundschaft auf eine harte Probe gestellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack Rat
programme.desc: Carly muss eingreifen, als sie bemerkt, dass Spencer eine Videospielsucht entwickelt. Währenddessen versucht Sam Freddie davon zu überzeugen, dass er vom Pech verfolgt sein wird, wenn er eine Ketten-Email nicht weiterleitet.

programme.title: iCarly: Raus aus den Schulden
programme.desc: Sam ist beschämt als Freddie und Carly ihr sagen, wieviel Geld sie ihnen bereits schuldig ist. Sam versucht alles, um es ihnen zurückzuzahlen. Sie überlegt sogar, sich einen richtigen Job zu beschaffen.

programme.title: iCarly: Achtung, böser Stiefvater!
programme.desc: Bei iCarly startet mal wieder die Rubrik 'Jetzt zeigen wir's Lewbert'. Dabei wird Lewbert durch eine Explosion verletzt. Die Kids wollen den Protier wieder gesund pflegen. Doch dann springt Mrs. Benson ein und es kommt zu einer kleinen Romanze.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokosnusscremtorte
programme.desc: Als Carly und Co. Freddie zu ihrem Lieblingskuchenladen bringen, erfahren sie, dass der Besitzer verstorben ist und auch seine Rezepte eventuell für immer verloren sein könnten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gut geküsst ist halb gewonnen
programme.desc: Sam bekommt mit, wie Freddie Carly gesteht, niemals ein Mädchen geküsst zu haben und veröffentlicht dieses Geheimnis auf der Webseite.

programme.title: iCarly: Auto oder Aus
programme.desc: Jeffrey, angeblich Sohn von Autohändler Mr. Flanken, will bei iCarly ein Preisausschreiben starten. Der erste Preis, ein neues Auto, soll von seinem Vater gestiftet werden. Nevel gewinnt den Preis, nur stellt sich die Frage, ob es das Auto wirklich gibt.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie gegen Fred
programme.desc: Freddie bekennt ganz offen seinen Unmut über Freds Popularität im Internet, was den sensiblen Fred dazu bringt, seine Videos nicht länger online zu stellen. Doch jetzt sind die Fans unglücklich!

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Colt für alle Fälle
programme.desc: Carly, Sam und Freddie bekommen die Möglichkeit, mit dem bekannten Kampfsportler Jackson Colt ein Interview zu machen. Und zwar backstage während einer Martial-Arts-Veranstaltung.

programme.title: iCarly: Wurzeln, Beeren und Kompost
programme.desc: Mr. Henning fordert im Naturwissenschaftsunterricht Carly und Co. auf, ein umweltfreundliches Projekt zur Grünen Woche zu entwickeln. Carly baut einen illegalen Atomkraft- Generator.

programme.title: iCarly: Amerika singt
programme.desc: Bei 'Amerika singt' steht das Finale an: David Archuleta gegen Wade Collins. iCarly ruft während der Web-Show dazu auf, für David Archuleta zu stimmen. Das Gewissen nagt an Carly und Co., so dass sie ein Musikvideo für den Verlierer machen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam ist ein Mädchen
programme.desc: Sam hat Geburtstag und Carly organisiert für sie eine große Feier. Viele sagen ein paar Worte zu Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly lernt einen richtigen Bad Boy kennen. Sie ist von Griffin zuerst gar nicht begeistert, verliebt sich aber schließlich in ihn, was wiederum Spencer überhaupt nicht gefällt. Carly und Griffin versuchen alles, um sich weiter sehen zu können.

programme.title: iCarly: Hier kommt Missy
programme.desc: Als Carlys alte Freundin Missy aus Seattle zurückzieht, glaubt Sam, Missy wolle sie als Carlys beste Freundin verdrängen. Sam riecht zwar den Braten, aber weder Freddie noch Carly wollen ihr glauben. Ob Missys wahre Absichten dennoch entlarvt werden?

programme.title: iCarly: Gib mir iCarly zurück!

programme.title: iCarly: Spind 239
programme.desc: Sam und Freddie haben bei einem schulinternen Wettbewerb gemeinsam den begehrten Spind 239 gewonnen. Doch das Teilen will nicht so recht klappen. Carly bekommt von Spencer Kunstunterricht.

programme.title: Hum Dekhengay
programme.desc: News show hosted by Mansoor Ali Khan, encapsulating the most headline-worthy & important stories of the day with analytical backgrounds and relevant analysis.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert. When she gets the opportunity to see her favorite artist, her dreams quickly spiral into a horrific nightmare of imprisonment and shady deals.

programme.title: We in This Together
programme.desc: Attorney August marries Daisha, a social climber more interested in his bank account than motherhood. To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old "Lil August," sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen’s lethal behavior as "playful," Daisha finds herself trapped in a house with a son who may be a killer. As she plots to conceive a biological heir, a series of dark secrets and "accidents" leave the family’s survival in question.

programme.title: Hoodie Girls Gang
programme.desc: Kayla's boyfriend Jamal is jailed and needs $10,000 bail. Desperate, Kayla and her friends plan an armed robbery. However, the heist goes wrong, and the police are on their trail. To make matters worse, Jamal's boss, Sean, demands payment for the drugs Jamal was transporting. Kayla must now free Jamal and escape town before both the police and Sean catch up to her.

programme.title: Double Standards 2
programme.desc: When Pastor Noble Jonez’s carefully constructed image begins to unravel, his wife Trezjiir is forced to confront not only the trauma of her past but the deceit poisoning her present. As buried secrets resurface—ranging from infidelity, hidden paternity, abuse of power, and criminal ties—every lie brings them closer to destruction.

programme.title: Room Available
programme.desc: When Emily rents a room from a seemingly kind landlord, she discovers his house hides deadly secrets — including past tenants, jealous lovers, and a dark obsession that may cost her life.

programme.title: Scarred
programme.desc: Nate meets and hooks up with the beautiful Mia after a night out. Everything is beautiful, until Nate’s wife Kamryn discovers his infidelity. The love triangle begins to spiral as everyone is on edge, and that some actions have deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Honeymoon
programme.desc: On her birthday, Summer is publicly humiliated when her fiancé, Chance, and her best friend, Portia, reveal their affair. Seeking revenge, she sabotages their honeymoon with the help of her friend Danisha. A deadly game of cat-and-mouse ensues, with betrayal, violence, and unexpected twists. Ultimately, Summer must confront the consequences of her actions as she fights for her life and seeks justice.

programme.title: Judge Knott
programme.desc: A father’s horrible mistake causes a lifetime of pain for his children. His son tries his best to live a normal life, but his childhood trauma follows him into his marriage. He must face his trauma head on to break this generational curse.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Kiss Me Once
programme.desc: Gabrielle, a delusional romantic, fixates on anyone who shows her the slightest interest. Her obsession turns dangerous when her feelings aren't reciprocated.

programme.title: Threaded Lies
programme.desc: When rising fashion designer Dante prepares to launch his brand, haunting messages and resurfaced betrayals from his former partner threaten to unravel everything. As paranoia sets in, Dante must confront the lies he’s built his success on before they destroy him.

programme.title: All the Love
programme.desc: A young woman begins her journey to adulthood, navigating love and self-discovery, while being haunted by a mysterious past that she can’t fully remember. As murders and violence swirl around her, she wonders who she can trust. Will she find love or suffer the same mysterious fate as her birth parents?

programme.title: Don Dada
programme.desc: Desperate to survive a brutal Chicago winter, Rah Jah and Tee Tee hustle for food and shelter in the streets. When a botched deal lands him in the hands of powerful crime bosses, he rises to the top of the hierarchy at a deadly cost.

programme.title: Apex
programme.desc: A special ops team enters the underground bunker "Hades" to rescue missing scientists, only to uncover a terrifying secret far beyond their expectations.

programme.title: CUT
programme.desc: Bunny is attempting to rebuild her life in Atlanta. Her financial aid suddenly falls through, until she meets Renee who shows her the ways of hustling and fast money, as well as Ed, a music producer and drug addict. Will her bad choices and mistake take her down the wrong path?

programme.title: What I'd Do For Love
programme.desc: Greer Patterson’s happy marriage falls apart when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. After exacting bitter revenge, she’s back on the market looking for love, and anyone standing in her way will see just how far she’ll go.

programme.title: Risk it All
programme.desc: Sierra, a gifted but overlooked painter, struggles to balance her artistic dreams with the reality of a stable life alongside her devoted but practical husband, Marcus. When a powerful and seductive art collector offers her the recognition she’s always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines and desire turns dangerous. As passion, obsession, and betrayal collide, she must decide how much she’s truly willing to sacrifice to be seen.

programme.title: Fatal Promises
programme.desc: Haunted by unresolved trauma, Renae Morgan swears off love until Kingston Coleman, a charming and powerful attorney, pulls her back in. When his lies and betrayal begin to surface, Renae turns to Eric, a loyal longtime friend, and together their search for truth spirals into obsession, revenge, and deadly consequences.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she’s forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.title: Ultimatums
programme.desc: Roman visits recently engaged Luke and his sexually frustrated fiancé Mya. Mya is forced into an internal battle between being faithful to her fiancé and sexual tension between their new house guest who has an ulterior motive of his own.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Alex becomes obsessed with finding out why Harry had secreted away so many things.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kevin returns unexpectedly and Jodi tells him the news about her real father. He isn't too surprised, though.
